title: [Withholding Tax] FCY documents get wrongly rounded to LCY precision …
summary: Foreign currency withholding tax documents no longer incorrectly round amounts to local currency precision, fixing a calculation issue in withholding tax management.
key_points: Withholding tax amounts in foreign currency documents were being rounded using local currency precision instead of the correct currency's precision
Corrected the rounding logic in the withholding tax management codeunit
Added test cases to verify correct rounding behavior for foreign currency transactions
